scopedCoverageNotes.text: All 652 styles in the current public Erie County 2026 General Election sample catalog were acquired as native structured sample JSON. Each has SAMPLE BALLOT / November 03, 2026 headers. All 2,529 local field occurrences agree across styles and with the native official county inventory: 40 complete fields and 60 ordinary named candidates. Coverage is the complete currently published sample catalog and English candidate fields; it does not assert separate unlisted formats or off-cycle elections.

The public sample app normally sets X-CSRF: 1. Reproducing its published nonsecret request format resolved direct GET 401 responses without voter identity, login, token or cookie. All acquisition was public read-only sample/catalog access; no ballot choice, print, transaction, registration, filing or submission was performed. County dynamic web pages looped through cookie-detection redirects, but native county PDFs and the public sample host worked. Every failed route remains in access findings.

The Eighth Judicial District contest and all seven candidate identities are reused exactly from held NY data. Eight already-held whole-county judicial membership identities are retained with current official court-scope corroboration. No per-county duplicate regional court race is created. The other 39 offices / 53 names are new local additions after comparison against the held input, latest parent-copied CX-VOTES NY input, and all currently prepared NY county packets.

County legislative fields use exact LD-01 through LD-11 electorates, never Erie County as a substitute. Generic accessible sample headings are paired with complete matching candidate blocks in the official county PDF to establish each numbered legislative district. Town offices use registered county-qualified town keys, including the Town of Tonawanda; Buffalo City Court uses the City of Buffalo. Villages, CDPs, towns and cities are not interchanged.

Federal/statewide/legislative races and all 13 observed Buffalo/Amherst/Cheektowaga question fields are outside this candidate additions packet. Existing measures and explanations remain unchanged. No school, special-district, mayoral, other city, party-position or off-cycle contest is invented. The complete current samples and county office inventory identify no additional November local candidate field.

Blank Write-in slots are retained in source/audit counts and never converted to people. No separately named declared write-in, cancelled field or declared-elected status was found in the complete current sample/inventory set; separate status files make no broader certification claim. Ordinary unopposed named candidates remain active fields where the sample supplies an actual voting choice.

Candidate facts are data-ready. Exact county legislative geography remains a River/reader dependency. A regional judicial key absent from the registry already has eight held whole-county memberships. Missing reader keys are explicitly listed and no reader visibility is claimed.
